Theme Reveal Slider

An interactive before/after slider comparing light and dark themes.

Dark Mode

Light Mode


<!-- Theme Reveal Slider -->
<div class="relative w-full h-[350px] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-700 select-none shadow-2xl">
    <!-- Dark Mode -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black text-white flex items-center justify-center">
        <h2 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight">Dark Mode</h2>
    </div>

    <!-- Light Mode -->
    <div id="light-layer" class="absolute inset-0 bg-gray-100 text-black flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none" style="clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0);">
        <h2 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight">Light Mode</h2>
    </div>

    <!-- Range Slider -->
    <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" id="theme-slider" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-ew-resize z-20">
    
    <!-- Divider Handle -->
    <div id="ruler" class="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-1/2 w-1 bg-white shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] -ml-[2px] pointer-events-none z-10 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div class="absolute w-10 h-10 bg-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg border border-gray-200">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2.5" d="M8 8l-4 4 4 4m8-8l4 4-4 4"></path>
            </svg>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const slider = document.getElementById('theme-slider');
    const lightLayer = document.getElementById('light-layer');
    const ruler = document.getElementById('ruler');

    slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        lightLayer.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - e.target.value}% 0 0)`;
        ruler.style.left = `${e.target.value}%`;
    });
</script>

Animated Image Card

A content card with an image cover and smooth hover animations.

Retro Lobby

Explore the oldest retro in spatial computing and feel the premiumness of the old items. Discover how the things changes according to the time line. 


                        <!-- 'group' class allows us to trigger inner animations when the card is hovered -->
<div class="group w-full max-w-sm bg-[#161616] border border-gray-700 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-purple-500/10">
    
    <!-- Image Container -->
    <div class="w-full h-48 overflow-hidden">
        <img src="YOUR_IMAGE_URL.jpg" alt="Cover" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-110" />
    </div>

    <!-- Content Area -->
    <div class="p-6">
        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Virtual Reality Insights</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm mb-5 line-clamp-3">
            Explore the latest advancements in spatial computing and eye-tracking technology. Discover how binocular VR is changing the landscape of interactive experiences.
        </p>

        <!-- Read More Button -->
        <button class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors">
            Read More
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-x-1">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.5 4.5 21 12m0 0-7.5 7.5M21 12H3" />
            </svg>
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

Auto Image Slider

A Smooth, automatically cross-fading image carousel.

Discover the World

Automatic sliding gallery


                    <!-- Auto Fading Slider -->
<div class="relative w-full h-[300px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl bg-black">
    <!-- Images -->
    <img id="slide-1" src="image1.jpg" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-1000 opacity-100" alt="Slide 1">
    <img id="slide-2" src="image2.jpg" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-1000 opacity-0" alt="Slide 2">
    <img id="slide-3" src="image3.jpg" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-1000 opacity-0" alt="Slide 3">
    
    <!-- Gradient Overlay & Text -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent flex flex-col justify-end p-6 z-10">
        <h3 class="text-white font-bold text-xl">Discover the World</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-300 text-sm">Automatic sliding gallery</p>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    // Slider Logic
    let currentSlide = 1;
    const totalSlides = 7;

    setInterval(() => {
        // Hide current slide
        document.getElementById(`slide-${currentSlide}`).classList.replace('opacity-100', 'opacity-0');
        
        // Move to next slide
        currentSlide = currentSlide === totalSlides ? 1 : currentSlide + 1;
        
        // Show next slide
        document.getElementById(`slide-${currentSlide}`).classList.replace('opacity-0', 'opacity-100');
    }, 3000); // Changes every 3 seconds
</script>
